sourceInformation.genre: Racing simulation with career, tuning and car collecting
sourceInformation.perspective: Third-person chase camera, bonnet view, television replay cameras; 3D diorama menus
sourceInformation.tech: Pixel Engine 0.46.0 (three.js r186, Rapier), plain JavaScript modules, esbuild, AI Hub session client 1.4.0
sourceInformation.artDirection: Engine native 480x270 pixel art, toon materials, Sweetie 16 palette, side-profile slab car models
sourceInformation.animation: Engine rig, HERO_CLIPS and new ClipDefs, procedural car body motion, tweens

sourceInformation.online: AI Hub ghost-mode session round; local split-screen Couch Duel

aiHub.name: Gran Tourniquet
aiHub.tagline: A slow and serious motoring life
aiHub.description: A calm racing career on the Halcyon Peninsula: buy a tired hatchback, earn three licences and race for a prototype.
